notes: M07-09 provider-dependency review. Records every external feed/provider this implementation depends on, its lifecycle status, and the required behaviour when it is unavailable: the system reports stale/unknown for the affected capability and keeps other capabilities usable. No provider is assumed current or permanently available; no historical dataset is assumed to still be produced. References [P0x] are the plan's revalidation list.

dependencies.failure_mode: collection fails closed with exit 4; no partial report is written
dependencies.assumption: git is installed and pinned by version evidence captured per scan
dependencies.rights: tool licence reviewed; no data redistribution

used_for: offline advisory matching from full records
explicit single package/version or full commit-hash query through the fixed OSV API endpoint
explicit graph batches of up to 64 versioned nodes through querybatch
opt-in full advisory hydration by returned ID through the fixed vulnerability endpoint
dependencies.failure_mode: query transport or response validation fails closed; a missing/withdrawn advisory is unknown, never 'not vulnerable'; opt-in single-query pagination follows at most four pages and leaves more_available with partial state at the cap; graph batches follow only per-query cursors for at most four rounds, retain indexed page evidence, and save remaining requests with partial state at the cap; hydration retains each attempt and marks ID, provider, record, or budget gaps partial
dependencies.assumption: one bounded package/version-string or full commit-hash query is implemented per invocation; opt-in pagination retains and hashes at most four pages; graph batches submit at most 64 eligible nodes and return ID/modification summaries, follow only outstanding query items for up to four rounds, and mark skipped, omitted, or unfinished cases partial; opt-in full-record hydration deduplicates at most 64 URL-safe IDs and 32 MiB of record bodies within 120 seconds total and 10 seconds per request, and verifies each returned ID; OSV matches versions fuzzily, capture time does not establish feed freshness, complete lockfile coverage remains open, and OSV data can be incomplete or stale
dependencies.rights: aggregated advisory records retain source IDs and links; underlying source terms vary, so public redistribution is not enabled and attribution is required per record

dependencies.failure_mode: adapter absent; any future use must carry coverage/origin and is not enabled here
dependencies.assumption: do not assume API stability or coverage without a captured fixture
dependencies.rights: review required before enabling; see source-review register process

dependencies.failure_mode: never consumed; importing it would risk a popularity/safety claim, which is prohibited (S011, R030)
dependencies.assumption: a retired external dataset is not assumed current; it is not consumed at all

used_for: bounded captured package lookup and one explicitly requested live package lookup; output is enrichment evidence only
dependencies.failure_mode: the fixed endpoint can fail or return 429 from its shared unauthenticated quota; no retries or batch requests occur, raw status/error evidence is retained, and malformed/oversized responses fail closed
dependencies.assumption: one bounded lookup per explicit CLI invocation; provider identifiers and source links remain candidate assertions and do not replace local canonical identity or dependency resolution
dependencies.rights: ecosyste.ms data is CC BY-SA 4.0: attribute ecosyste.ms, link the licence, and state that fields were filtered; downstream public adaptations must preserve compatible share-alike terms. Review commercial or database-rights use for the specific context.

used_for: defines how a future reproducibility claim must be stated
dependencies.failure_mode: not implemented; build success is never equated with reproducibility
dependencies.assumption: a reproducibility claim requires defined source+environment+instructions
